description: This file defines a report for process loss in manufacturing, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data via SQL queries, and compute loss values, specific to the manufacturing process loss report in ERPNext.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes data for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Executes SQL query to retrieve manufacturing process loss data.

methods.name: update_data_with_total_pl_value
methods.description: Calculates total process loss value per row.

methods.name: get_filter_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL filter conditions based on provided filters.
